_help: Global alert settings. What to search and the rules live in kinds/<name>.json (one file per kind of product: monitor, tv, ...). Phone push topic: data/ntfy_topic.txt locally, NTFY_TOPIC secret in GitHub Actions ('monitores-<id>'; each kind gets '<topic>-<id>'). Listings found only around a non-primary center (Utrecht) must cost at most other_center_price_factor x the rule's max_price; heavily damaged ones at most heavy_damage_price_factor x (both multiply), and they only notify with a value percentile >= heavy_min_percentile (scored at 10 % of the fair value). damage = warn: damaged listings still notify with a light/heavy damage line; skip: never. With lowball = true, listings asking more than a rule's max_price but taking bids also notify when min(1.5 x the highest bid, or 1.5 x the minimum bid if nobody bid, asking price) is strictly under max_price. Test changes with: python -I alert.py test

ai._help: DeepSeek check (ai.py) of every listing about to be notified and of listings missing a key fact (TV resolution/Smart, monitor size/resolution). Needs the DEEPSEEK_API_KEY secret. ~0.5 cent per listing.
